title: Before National Day: PPTs, Russian and a Viral Hit
description: Steven looks back on his first month teaching university English in China: packed office hours, ten-minute AI-assisted PowerPoint tasks, and freshmen still worn out from the gaokao. He also covers a rough Russian lesson, his frustration over a rejected permanent-residence application, and a Singapore underpass video that unexpectedly took off on Instagram.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Quick overview

sentences.zh: 这期节目录于国庆长假前夕。
sentences.en: This episode was recorded just before the National Day holiday.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文刚跑完步，心情轻松，大学教学的第一个月也顺利收尾。
sentences.en: Steven has just finished a run and is in a relaxed mood, and his first month of university teaching has also wrapped up smoothly.

sentences.zh: 他聊了排满的答疑时间、十分钟的AI辅助PPT任务，还有大一新生身上仍未卸下的高考压力。
sentences.en: He talks about his fully booked office hours, a ten-minute AI-assisted PowerPoint assignment, and the gaokao pressure that freshmen still haven't shaken off.

sentences.zh: 接着话题转到他自己：一节糟糕的俄语课，“永居”申请被拒的懊恼，以及一条他自己都解释不了为什么在Instagram上爆火的新加坡视频。
sentences.en: Then the topic turns to himself: a bad Russian lesson, his frustration at having his permanent residency application rejected, and a Singapore video that went viral on Instagram for reasons even he can't explain.

sentences.zh: 国庆前夕：健身、上课和答疑
sentences.en: On the eve of National Day: working out, teaching and office hours

sentences.zh: 周三史蒂文九点五十五才上班，所以课前先举了铁。
sentences.en: On Wednesday Steven didn't start work until 9:55, so he lifted weights before class.

sentences.zh: 下午五点有俄语课，他把跑步安排在了前后。
sentences.en: He had a Russian class at 5 p.m., and he scheduled his run around it.

sentences.zh: 他承认自己“最近上课安排得太雄心勃勃了”，假期里得改一改。
sentences.en: He admits he's "been way too ambitious with his class schedule lately" and needs to change things over the holiday.

sentences.zh: 他只有一节课，之后是将近四个小时的答疑时间。
sentences.en: He only had one class, followed by almost four hours of office hours.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文直言不讳：这其实就是一对一辅导，还要扫二维码登记。
sentences.en: Steven doesn't mince words: it's really just one-on-one tutoring, and students even have to scan a QR code to sign in.

sentences.zh: 他的态度是：“你愿意叫它答疑时间，那就叫吧。”
sentences.en: His attitude is: "If you want to call it office hours, then call it that."

sentences.zh: 他依然喜欢和新生聊天，用直接的问题把他们的英语“逼”出来。
sentences.en: He still enjoys chatting with the new students, using direct questions to "force" their English out of them.

sentences.zh: 学期目标与一记作业警钟
sentences.en: Semester Goals and a Homework Wake-Up Call

sentences.zh: 史蒂文请学生为英语写作和口语定下学期目标。
sentences.en: Steven asks his students to set semester goals for English writing and speaking.

sentences.zh: 很多课本来就是英文授课，所以怎样让自己的课不无聊，得靠他自己。
sentences.en: Many classes are already taught in English, so it's up to him to keep his own class from being boring.

sentences.zh: 本周作业是五篇“重点文章”中的第一篇，外加必交的阅读日志（RRJ）。
sentences.en: This week's homework is the first of five "key articles," plus the required reading journal (RRJ).

sentences.zh: 有一个班，一半男生没做。
sentences.en: In one class, half the boys didn't do it.

sentences.zh: 于是他给全班拍了照，在每个没交作业的学生头上标了个数字。
sentences.en: So he took a photo of the whole class and marked a number above the head of every student who hadn't turned in their homework.

sentences.zh: “这下把他们吓到了。”
sentences.en: "That scared them."

sentences.zh: 现在大家都知道，老师是记着账的。
sentences.en: Now everyone knows the teacher is keeping track.

sentences.zh: 十分钟做PPT
sentences.en: Making a PowerPoint in ten minutes

sentences.zh: 主要活动是十分钟内做出PPT并上台讲解。
sentences.en: The main activity was making a PowerPoint in ten minutes and then going up to present it.

sentences.zh: 每组做四张幻灯片，一人一张。
sentences.en: Each group made four slides, one per person.

sentences.zh: 可以用AI，前提是信息要正确。
sentences.en: They could use AI, as long as the information was correct.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文发现DeepSeek做不了PPT文件，豆包可以，他猜学生用的就是豆包。
sentences.en: Steven found that DeepSeek can't make PowerPoint files but Doubao can, so he guesses the students were using Doubao.

sentences.zh: 这些学生都是学编程的，这本来就是将来要用的技能。
sentences.en: These students are all studying programming, so this is a skill they'll need in the future anyway.

sentences.zh: 真正的目的是让他们琢磨内容、练习口语。
sentences.en: The real goal is to get them thinking through the content and practicing their spoken language.

sentences.zh: AI能给你大意，“但要真正明白文章在讲什么，还得你自己坐下来认真读。”
sentences.en: AI can give you the gist, "but to really understand what an article is saying, you still have to sit down and read it carefully yourself."

sentences.zh: 小测还是PPT？还有分组风波
sentences.en: A quiz or PowerPoint? Plus a grouping controversy

sentences.zh: 其他老师都出了小测，却没人给史蒂文一份。
sentences.en: All the other teachers had made quizzes, but nobody gave Steven a copy.

sentences.zh: 用ChatGPT做一份像样的测验“费时费力”，而且多数学生更喜欢做PPT。
sentences.en: Making a decent quiz with ChatGPT takes "a lot of time and effort," and most students prefer making PowerPoints anyway.

sentences.zh: 第二篇文章会安排一次不许用手机的小测验，不计入成绩，不过学生还不知道。
sentences.en: For the second text there will be a no-phones quiz that won't count toward grades, but the students don't know that yet.

sentences.zh: 今年他只需批改两次考试，重点放在口语。
sentences.en: This year he only has to grade two exams, with the focus on speaking.

sentences.zh: “你能不能进行一场对话？不管AI帮了多少忙，这一点都不会变。”
sentences.en: "Can you hold a conversation? No matter how much AI helps, that won't change."

sentences.zh: 学生照样对着幻灯片念稿，也没遵守四张的限制，但头一次演讲，他选择睁一只眼闭一只眼。
sentences.en: The students still read their scripts off the slides and ignored the four-slide limit, but since it was their first presentation, he chose to turn a blind eye.

sentences.zh: 他按学号分组，好打破小圈子。
sentences.en: He grouped them by student number to break up cliques.

sentences.zh: 有学生抱怨组里有人口语太弱，史蒂文回答：每次分的组都不一样。
sentences.en: When a student complained that someone in their group had weak speaking skills, Steven replied: the groups will be different every time.

sentences.zh: 高考之后的喘息
sentences.en: A breather after the gaokao

sentences.zh: 史蒂文打趣说，中国可能是唯一一个刚开学就放假的国家。
sentences.en: Steven joked that China might be the only country where you go on holiday right after school starts.

sentences.zh: 不过他很理解：学生们为高考奋战了一年，又搬到新城市，还遇上一个语速飞快、留着胡子的外国老师。
sentences.en: But he completely understands: the students had battled for a whole year for the gaokao, then moved to a new city, and on top of that ran into a fast-talking, bearded foreign teacher.

sentences.zh: 他把过去这一年称作“一场闯关”，还发现不少学生更怕数学，而不是英语。
sentences.en: He called the past year "a level-by-level challenge," and also found that many students were more afraid of math than of English.

sentences.zh: 有学生问，为了凑字数能不能硬写。
sentences.en: A student asked whether it's okay to force out extra writing just to hit the word count.

sentences.zh: 他拿雅思举例：拿七分、八分的人，写得都远超最低要求。
sentences.en: He used IELTS as an example: people who score a 7 or 8 all write far more than the minimum requirement.

sentences.zh: 题目要求150词，“你就该写300词”。
sentences.en: If the task asks for 150 words, "you should write 300."

sentences.zh: 答疑时间：播客的金矿
sentences.en: Q&A Time: A Goldmine for Podcasts

sentences.zh: 史蒂文很喜欢这份工作，还承认最轻松的人可能就是他自己，只等发工资。
sentences.en: Steven really enjoys this job, and even admits that the most relaxed person is probably himself, just waiting to get paid.

sentences.zh: 小班加一对一，“简直是金矿，特别适合做播客。”
sentences.en: Small classes plus one-on-one sessions: "It's simply a goldmine, perfect for making podcasts."

sentences.zh: 接下来是视频作业。
sentences.en: Next up is the video assignment.

sentences.zh: 学生们担心做不到，其实只需拍一页书，放进剪映，再配上语音就行。
sentences.en: The students worry they can't do it, but really all they need to do is film a page of a book, put it into CapCut, and add a voiceover.

sentences.zh: 道理很简单：保持简洁，用AI，但别丢了真实感。
sentences.en: The principle is simple: keep it concise, use AI, but don't lose the authenticity.

sentences.zh: 为什么还要学俄语？
sentences.en: Why keep learning Russian?

sentences.zh: 史蒂文没准备俄语课，结果“惨不忍睹……像被钝器砸了脑袋”。
sentences.en: Steven didn't prepare for his Russian lesson, and the result was "a disaster... like being hit on the head with a blunt object."

sentences.zh: 他不会动词变位，还把“铅笔”（karandash）忘得一干二净。
sentences.en: He couldn't conjugate verbs, and he had completely forgotten the word for "pencil" (karandash).

sentences.zh: 那为什么还坚持？
sentences.en: So why does he stick with it?

sentences.zh: “它让我保持谦逊”，还能让他亲自检验推荐给学生的学习方法。
sentences.en: "It keeps me humble," and it also lets him personally test the learning methods he recommends to his students.

sentences.zh: 一篇关于“永居”被拒的文章，勾起了他自己的旧伤。
sentences.en: An article about a rejected "permanent residency" application reopened an old wound of his own.

sentences.zh: 原因只是个小失误，“日子错了”，他现在“更生气了”。
sentences.en: The reason was just a small mistake—"the date was wrong"—and now he's "even angrier."

sentences.zh: 这让他开始怀疑自己对中文和对中国的投入，尽管老师们都说他中文不错。
sentences.en: This made him start to question his investment in Chinese and in China, even though his teachers all say his Chinese is good.

sentences.zh: 他在基辅的乌克兰语老师用的是卡兰方法，练习的是“这是钢笔吗？不，是铅笔”之类的句子。
sentences.en: His Ukrainian teacher in Kyiv uses the Callan method, practicing sentences like "Is this a pen? No, it's a pencil."

sentences.zh: 虽然幼稚，但他在A2水平停了十年，正需要这个。
sentences.en: It's childish, but after being stuck at A2 level for ten years, it's exactly what he needs.

sentences.zh: 发薪日、黄金和意外爆款
sentences.en: Payday, gold, and an unexpected hit

sentences.zh: 史蒂文刚刚才知道，工资是每月5号发，不是月底。
sentences.en: Steven only just found out that his salary is paid on the 5th of each month, not at the end of the month.

sentences.zh: 黄金价格正好，这让人有点懊恼。
sentences.en: The gold price is just right, which is a little frustrating.

sentences.zh: 明天是写给长期在华居住者的中国历史特别节目。
sentences.en: Tomorrow is a special Chinese history episode for long-term residents of China.

sentences.zh: 照例声明：“不构成投资建议。”
sentences.en: The usual disclaimer: "Not investment advice."

sentences.zh: 与此同时，他的《新加坡地下通道》视频在Instagram上达到了1.9万次观看。
sentences.en: Meanwhile, his "Singapore Underpass" video reached 19,000 views on Instagram.

sentences.zh: “我以前从没遇到过这种事。”
sentences.en: "This has never happened to me before."

sentences.zh: 视频里是他、女朋友、她姐姐和外甥女，晚上十点左右在一条地下通道里，周围是街舞、滑板和韩流舞者。
sentences.en: The video shows him, his girlfriend, her older sister, and her niece in an underpass around 10 p.m., surrounded by street dancers, skateboarders, and K-pop dancers.

sentences.zh: 它在YouTube上只有大约一千次观看。
sentences.en: On YouTube it only has about a thousand views.

sentences.zh: 他怀疑背后是新加坡的推广。
sentences.en: He suspects Singapore's promotion is behind it.

sentences.zh: 他的Instagram粉丝从58涨到了近100。
sentences.en: His Instagram followers went from 58 to nearly 100.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 史蒂文带着对教学的从容迈进国庆假期，不确定自己为什么还在学俄语和中文，也对一条莫名爆红的视频一头雾水。
sentences.en: Steven heads into the National Day holiday feeling at ease about teaching. He's not sure why he's still learning Russian and Chinese, and he's baffled by a video that went viral for no clear reason.

sentences.zh: 祝大家国庆快乐，来自中国。
sentences.en: Happy National Day, everyone, from China.

vocab.en: to answer students' questions; office hours

vocab.py: zhēng yì zhī yǎn bì yì zhī yǎn

vocab.en: breathing room; a moment to catch one's breath
to get through a series of challenges
